info.name: Maintain Ops Suite
info.summary: Configuration, Preventive Maintenance, and Deficiency Tracking for field operations teams
info.description:
Maintain Ops Suite is an integrated operations management platform built for field operations teams, with three core modules:
**Configuration Tracker** — Hardware, software, and firmware digital twin. Assets are fully cross-linked so you always know what software and firmware runs on which hardware and where it lives.
**Preventive Maintenance** — Schedule and track PM procedures linked to configuration assets. Track periodicity, last completed, next due date, assigned technician, and linked SOP documents. Automatically calculates next-due dates and flags overdue items. Captures actual hours, parts cost, labor cost, and completion notes on closeout.
**Deficiency Tracking** — Log and manage deficiencies found during PM inspections or discovered on walkdowns. Tracks severity (SEV-1 through SEV-5), troubleshooting history, cost estimates (parts/labor/contractor), man-days, outside entity requirements, and assignment to Nextcloud users. Full closeout workflow captures root cause, corrective action, and actual costs.
Pairs with the Maintain Ops Suite Android app for field technician mobile access.
